markers.intent: the required reader is absent.

markers.statement: createBrowserTextureProvider({ readBytes: (_ref: AssetRef<number>, _context: AssetLoadContext) => Promise.resolve(new Uint8Array(new ArrayBuffer(8))) });
markers.intent: the reader cannot substitute an invariant number ref.

markers.intent: required options are nonnull.

markers.name: BIP1-N11

markers.name: BIP1-N12
markers.statement: createBrowserTextureProvider({ readBytes, ports: { decode: () => undefined, createCanvas } });
markers.intent: decode cannot return void.

markers.name: BIP1-N13
markers.statement: createBrowserTextureProvider({ readBytes, ports: { decode: unknownDecode, createCanvas } });
markers.intent: unknown decode output cannot supply the ImageBitmap contract.

markers.statement: createBrowserTextureProvider({ readBytes, ports: { decode, createCanvas: () => ({ width: 1, height: 1 }) } });
markers.intent: the surface function must return a Canvas element.
